description: One social account's page-level figures on one day: followers (where Followers Read), net new followers, reach and views. Kept forever. Named from (account, date), so a restated day updates the same row.

fields.label: Followers Read
fields.description: Followers below is that day's real figure. An Int column is never blank in the database, so without this a day nobody read would look like zero followers.

fields.label: Followers
fields.description: Followers (subscribers on YouTube) at the end of that day: nightly from the day it is connected, and for past days where the network keeps them (Facebook's page_follows, two years). Blank otherwise.

fields.label: Net New Followers
fields.description: That day's follows minus unfollows where the network reports it: LinkedIn follower gains, YouTube subscribers gained minus lost. Blank where it does not.

fields.label: Reach
fields.description: Unique accounts reached that day. Facebook page_total_media_view_unique, Instagram reach, LinkedIn unique impressions. YouTube reports none, so its rows read 0 here and the page shows a dash.

fields.label: Views
fields.description: Facebook page_media_view, Instagram views, LinkedIn impressions, YouTube views.

name: Social Page Daily Metric
